name: Rill
description: Twin channels running side by side with a clean bank between them, swinging from upright to flat.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 6%; width: 15%; height: 88%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); ${round} -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 63%; top: 6%; width: 15%; height: 88%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); ${round} -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
